title: Spell books
description: More than 20 magic books, bosses and mobs, as well as a mana system
body:
# Spell Books

Magic has always remained beyond the reach of ordinary adventurers. But now, ancient knowledge is waiting to be uncovered.

**Spell Books** adds a magical progression system to Minecraft, centered around spellbooks, elemental powers, unique equipment, structures, and powerful bosses.

## 📚 Spellbooks

Discover and wield over **20 unique spellbooks**, each with its own abilities and playstyle. Command the forces of **Earth**, **Water**, **Air**, and many other forms of magic.

Cast spells using **mana**, experiment with different combinations, and find the magical path that suits you best.

## 🛡️ Schools of Magic

Strengthen your abilities with magical armor sets. The mod currently features equipment for the **Earth** and **Water** schools, empowering spellbooks of their respective elements.

More schools, armor sets, and magical content are planned for future updates.

## 🏰 Structures & Exploration

New structures can be found across the world, offering treasure, danger, and adventure.

Among them stands the mysterious **Astronomer's Tower** — a towering three-story structure filled with enemies, rewards, and powerful bosses waiting at its heights.

## 👑 Bosses

Face dangerous magical creatures and test your strength against formidable enemies.

Challenge the mighty **Queen of Stone-Eaters**, a fearsome boss guarding valuable rewards for those capable of defeating her.

## ✨ Begin Your Magical Journey

From mastering the elements to conquering ancient structures, **Spell Books** expands Minecraft with new ways to explore, fight, and wield the power of magic.



(I can't keep making mods, so I'm sharing what I have)
